question.text: How much funding will Wild Animal Initiative receive in 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the financial amount (in US Dollars) reported under "Contributions and grants" (Part 1, Section 8 - Revenue) in [the Form 990 tax filing](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466) for Wild Animal Initiative Inc. for the fiscal year ending December 2026.
question.fine_print: If Wild Animal Initiative ceases to exist or no Form 990 tax filing is made for the fiscal year ending December 2026, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I found nothing that settles the question yet. The 2026 Form 990 that decides it probably won't be filed until around August 2027. The most important new fact is that Open Philanthropy (now Coefficient Giving), which once paid for more than half of Wild Animal Initiative's (WAI's) budget, no longer funds wild animal welfare. Its grants were the source of the big 2021 and 2023 spikes.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2025-08-19: The latest filing on ProPublica is the 2024 Form 990: contributions $2,325,327, total revenue $2,487,849, expenses $3,345,940, net assets $6,716,700. ProPublica shows no 2025 Form 990 yet. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- The 2026 filing is likely to land around August-November 2027, in line with past filing dates.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet.
- There is a gap between sources: ACE's 2025 review gives WAI's 2024 revenue as $3.8M, while the 990 shows $2.33M. The likely reason is that the 990 records a multi-year grant in full in the year it is awarded. That would explain the jumps in 2021 ($3.5M grant) and 2023 ($6M grant), but I could not confirm it. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10 (scheduled): ACE announces its next two-year recommendations. I found no published 2026 list yet. [ACE recommended charities](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/recommended-charities/), [vegan-news](https://www.vegan-news.net/announcing-the-charities-under-evaluation-in-2026)
- 2026-10-31: Deadline for WAI's Validation and Seed Grant calls. Seed grants are up to $30k. [Terra Viva](https://www.terravivagrants.org/validation-grants-for-wild-animal-welfare/)
- 2026-08-24: ACE's Recommended Charity Fund granted WAI $339,295, part of a $1,365,823 distribution meant to cover the next six months. These distributions seem to happen roughly twice a year, but I did not confirm an earlier 2026 one. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/)
- 2026-06-23: WAI awarded 13 research grants totaling $727,658. The announcement names no funders. [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants)
- 2025-11-18: WAI's 2026 funding post set out these figures: [EA Forum](https://forum-bots.effectivealtruism.org/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p/funding-priorities-for-wild-animal-initiative-in-2026-1)
  - 2025 budget: $3,772,000.
  - 2026 target budget: $4,100,000. WAI said it was $267k short, which implies about $3.83M secured. I worked that out myself; the post doesn't state it.
  - Extra "aspirational" room: about $3.1M.
  - Open Philanthropy "no longer funds wild animal welfare." Other funders are "beginning to fill some of the gaps," and WAI got its first grants from non-EA (non-effective-altruism) foundations in 2025.
  - It planned to hire a Foundations Relations Manager.
- 2025 (ACE review): ACE projected 2025 revenue at about $3.8M and said WAI could effectively absorb $6.9M a year in 2026-27. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/)
- Earlier: Because of uncertainty after Open Philanthropy's exit, WAI planned to cut regranting from $2M to $670k. [EA Forum 2024 review](https://beta.effectivealtruism.org/posts/pEtxF6fJr5M6H5fbC/wild-animal-initiative-2024-review-and-2025-plans)

## 4. Base rates
- Contributions on the 990s: 2019 $0.72M; 2020 $0.61M; 2021 $5.09M; 2022 $1.72M; 2023 $6.82M; 2024 $2.33M.
- The pattern alternates: a big Open Philanthropy grant year ($3.5M in 2021, $6M in 2023), then a smaller year. [WAI 2023 grant](https://wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2023-op-grant)
- With Open Philanthropy gone, the high years may not recur. The 2022 and 2024 figures ($1.7M and $2.3M) are the closest examples of years without a big Open Philanthropy grant.
- Year-to-year swings have been huge: plus or minus 60-300%.
- Expenses have run at $3.3-4.4M a year and are budgeted at $4.1M for 2026. Net assets of $6.7M at the end of 2024 give reserves to cover a shortfall. There is no 2025 figure yet.
- Some money "secured" for 2026 may have been booked as 2025 (or earlier) revenue, which would lower the 2026 contributions figure. Whether this happened is unverified.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market or expert forecast on WAI's 2026 revenue on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus.
- A related Manifold market, "Which charities will be recommended by ACE at the end of 2026?", has WAI at 72%. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Tetraspace/which-charities-will-be-recommended-g0nIIZNdgU)
- Some sources say ACE now gives two-year recommendations, which would mean the 2025 one runs through 2026. WAI's media kit says it was recommended "2021 to 2026." [WAI media kit](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/media-kit)
- The Kalshi markets supplied with the question (ballot measures, French budget and similar) have nothing to do with this question.
- None of the news articles supplied with the question mention WAI.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-10: ACE's recommendation announcement. Being recommended drives Recommended Charity Fund grants and individual donations.
- Late November to December 2026: Giving Tuesday, the EA Forum's Marginal Funding Week, and year-end giving. December has historically been WAI's main period for individual fundraising.
- Any new large foundation grant or pledge announced before 2026-12-31. A multi-year grant could be booked entirely in 2026.
- Around mid-to-late 2027: the 2025 Form 990 will show the post-Open Philanthropy baseline. The 2026 990 resolves the question around 2027-11.

# Wild Animal Initiative: 2026 contributions and grants (Form 990 Part I, line 8)

The figure that decides this question won't be public until about late 2026 to late 2027. No 2025 or 2026 financials could be found. WAI's planned 2026 budget is about $4.1M to $4.3M. Its largest past funder, Open Philanthropy (now Coefficient Giving), has stopped funding wild animal welfare work. One accounting point matters a lot: past spikes in this line seem to come from large multi-year grants being booked in full in the year they were awarded. That is my inference from the 2021 and 2023 figures, not a confirmed fact.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-05: ProPublica's latest filing for EIN 82-2281466 is the FY2024 Form 990, filed 2025-08-19. It shows contributions of $2,325,327, total revenue $2,487,849, expenses $3,345,940 and net assets $6,716,700. There is no FY2025 filing yet, and the FY2026 filing is not due until 2027. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- The FY2024 return arrived about 7.5 months after year end. On a similar schedule, the FY2026 return would come around August 2027, before the question's resolution date of about 2027-11-15.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. I found no 2025 annual report, no FY2025 Form 990, and no partial 2026 revenue figure.
- A caution on figures: ACE gives WAI's 2024 revenue as $3.8M, against $2.33M of contributions on the Form 990. The two clearly use different bases, so ACE and WAI "revenue" numbers are not directly comparable to the line that resolves this question. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-31: Deadlines for WAI's Validation, Welfare Ecology and Seed grant calls. Welfare Ecology grants go up to $200k each and Seed grants up to $30k, which shows the grant program is still running. [Terra Viva](https://www.terravivagrants.org/wild-animal-welfare-ecology-grants/)
- 2026-08-14: Rethink Priorities lists WAI's 2026 budget at $4,280,000 and its 2027 room for more funding at $1.42M to $6.09M. It says WAI needs "moderately more funding in 2026 and 2027" and that the field relies on "a small number of funders." [Rethink Priorities](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/wild-animal-welfare-rfmf/)
- 2026-06-23: WAI awarded 13 research grants totalling $727,658. [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants)
- 2026 (date unclear): WAI posted a job ad for a "Philanthropy Officer 2026", in line with its plan to expand fundraising. [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/philanthropy-officer-1)
- 2025-11-18: WAI's EA Forum post. Its 2025 budget was $3,772,000 and its 2026 target budget $4,100,000, with $267k of that not yet funded. It also listed an "aspirational" extra $3.1M, including rodent contraception work and up to $2.2M for university programs. It said Open Philanthropy, once "more than half of our budget," no longer funds wild animal welfare, and that WAI received its first grants from non-EA foundations in 2025. [EA Forum mirror](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p)
- 2025 review: ACE named WAI a 2025 Recommended Charity. It estimates WAI could absorb $6.9M a year in 2026 and 2027, about $3.1M more than projected 2025 revenue of roughly $3.8M. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/)
- 2024-10-02: WAI's update on the funding landscape:
  - Good Ventures stopped allowing Open Philanthropy to fund wild animal welfare.
  - The last Open Philanthropy grant ran to 2026-06-30, at about $2M a year.
  - The Navigation Fund made a non-binding commitment of about $1M to cover the second half of 2026.
  - The Navigation Fund will decide in late 2026 whether to fund 2027. WAI saw a moderate chance of renewal for 2027 and a low chance after that.

  [EA Forum mirror](https://ea.greaterwrong.com/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/)
- 2024-10: The EA Animal Welfare Fund gave about $300k in general support for 2024-25. [LongtermWiki](https://www.longtermwiki.com/grants/nawhQ5mMeK)

## 4. Base rates
- Form 990 contributions by year: 2019 $0.72M, 2020 $0.61M, 2021 $5.09M, 2022 $1.72M, 2023 $6.82M, 2024 $2.33M.
- The pattern alternates between high and low years. The 2021 spike matches a $4M Open Philanthropy grant in June 2021, and 2023 probably reflects the multi-year Open Philanthropy grant that ran to mid-2026. [LongtermWiki](https://www.longtermwiki.com/grants/tVIMlCrL_f)
- Low years ($1.7M to $2.3M) appear to be closer to what actually comes in during a year without a big multi-year award.
- Without Open Philanthropy, a 2026 spike would need a large multi-year award booked in 2026, such as a Navigation Fund grant for 2027. It also matters whether the roughly $1M Navigation Fund grant for the second half of 2026 was booked in 2025 or 2026. I could not determine either point.
- 2024 expenses were $3.35M against $2.33M of contributions, with net assets of $6.7M left to draw down.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on WAI's funding. The Kalshi markets supplied with the question (Washington and California ballot measures, cannabis tax, France's budget) have nothing to do with it.
- The closest thing to an expert view is the ACE and Rethink Priorities estimates of funding capacity. These describe what WAI could spend, not what it will raise.

## 6. Upcoming events before forecasts close (2026-12-31)
- Late November 2026: the EA Forum's Marginal Funding Week (WAI posted in it in 2025). Also ACE's 2026 recommendations, which have usually come out in late November or early December, though I could not confirm the 2026 date. Keeping or losing ACE status affects money from the Recommended Charity Fund and individual donors.
- 2026-12-01: Giving Tuesday, the start of year-end giving.
- Late 2026: the Navigation Fund decides whether to fund WAI in 2027. A multi-year award signed before 2026-12-31 could raise the 2026 Form 990 figure considerably.
- Also any new non-EA foundation grants, and Coefficient Giving's multi-donor funds, which I found no sign of supporting WAI.
- About August to November 2027: the FY2026 Form 990 is filed and appears on ProPublica. The FY2025 Form 990, likely out in 2026, would show how the second-half-2026 Navigation Fund grant was booked.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) The 2026 Form 990 is likely to be filed around August to November 2027, so the outcome is known in about a year. The fiscal year itself still has about 8 weeks left, including year-end giving.

(b) The latest resolution-source value is $2,325,327 in contributions for FY2024, from the 2024 Form 990 shown on ProPublica as of 2025-08-19. There is no 2025 filing yet.

(c) If nothing changed, a non-Open Philanthropy year would land near the 2024 level, about $2.3M.

(d) If the current trend continued, WAI's 2026 budget is $4.1M, and in November 2025 it reported about $3.83M secured (my estimate from its stated $267k gap). Some of that money was probably booked in 2025 or earlier as multi-year awards, which would push the 2026 figure lower. Growing foundation fundraising, non-EA funders and ACE fund grants (about $0.68M a year) push it higher. On balance, contributions of about $2.5-3.5M look likely.

(e) Historical variation is very large: year-on-year swings of 60-300%, driven mostly by large Open Philanthropy grants that are booked in full when awarded. Without Open Philanthropy, swings should be smaller but still substantial, because any new multi-year grant would also be booked up front.

(f) There are no markets or expert forecasts on this quantity. ACE projected about $3.8M in revenue for 2025 and judged that WAI could absorb up to $6.9M a year. A Manifold market gives WAI a 72% chance of being an ACE-recommended charity at the end of 2026.

(g) Two unexpected scenarios:
- **Low:** Most 2026 funding was pre-booked in 2025, donors pull back, and WAI draws on reserves, giving about $1.2M.
- **High:** A new major funder, for example a large donor-advised fund or Navigation-type fund, or a non-EA foundation, makes a multi-year grant of $3M or more booked in 2026, pushing the total to $6-8M.

(a) **Time left:** Forecasts close on 2026-12-31. The resolving figure will appear in the FY2026 Form 990, which on past timing should be filed around August 2027. Resolution is about 2027-11-15, roughly 12 months away.

(b) **Latest known value:** FY2024 Form 990 "Contributions and grants" was $2,325,327 (filed 2025-08-19). No FY2025 figure is public yet.

(c) **If nothing changed:** About $2.3M, a repeat of the last "low" year without a large multi-year award.

(d) **If the trend continued:** The series alternates between high and low years, driven by multi-year Open Philanthropy awards booked up front:
- Open Philanthropy no longer funds this work, so the high-year pattern is broken.
- WAI's 2026 budget is about $4.1M to $4.3M, with only about $0.27M unfunded as of late 2025. Much of that budget is covered by net assets carried over from the 2023 grant.
- New 2026 inflows are likely to include:
  - The Navigation Fund's roughly $1M for the second half of 2026, if it is booked in 2026.
  - A possible Navigation Fund award for 2027, signed late in 2026.
  - EA Animal Welfare Fund and ACE fund money.
  - Individual donors.
  - New non-EA foundation grants.
- This points to roughly $2.5M to $3.5M.

(e) **Historical variation:** Year-to-year swings have been huge, from -66% to +740%. Excluding the spike years, the "organic" level has been $1.7M to $2.3M, which suggests about ±40% around a central figure.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There are no markets on this. The available estimates describe what WAI could spend, not what it will raise:
- Rethink Priorities gives a 2026 budget of $4.28M.
- ACE estimates WAI could absorb $6.9M a year.
- WAI itself reports a small 2026 funding gap but is expanding its fundraising.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** The Navigation Fund's second-half-2026 grant was booked in 2025, the 2027 decision slips into 2027, ACE drops WAI, and individual giving is weak. Contributions come in around $1.0M to $1.3M.
- **High:** The Navigation Fund signs a multi-year award in December 2026 that is booked in full, and a new non-EA foundation funds the aspirational university programs. Contributions reach $6M to $8M.
